messages.content: the sessions list is slow for big workspaces, find out why

I ran EXPLAIN ANALYZE on the list query against a copy of the biggest workspace (41k sessions). It does a sequential scan on `work_session` because the filter is on `(organizationId, archivedAt)` and there's only an index on `organizationId`; with the sort on `updatedAt` it reads every row, 1.8 s. A partial index `ON work_session ("organizationId", "updatedAt" DESC) WHERE "archivedAt" IS NULL` brings it to 12 ms in my test. Adding it is a migration with `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`, so it doesn't lock the table.
